articles.title: Letter: Support the Sidewalk Ramp
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the sidewalk ramp in the budget. Many of us on Salem Drive use it every week.

To the editor: I have lived on Salem Drive for 40 years, and I want to say what a difference the Canal Park Food Pantry has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the January meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the sidewalk ramp in the budget. Many of us on Salem Drive use it every week.
Felix Dalrymple, Lower Millrace
